summary: Gives recommendations to makers of home and small-office routers about the simple security features they should offer at the edge of an IPv6 network. It is informational and describes a baseline, not a full firewall design.

eli5.summary: A home router is like the front door of a house. This lists the basic locks the door should come with when the house uses the newer kind of internet addresses.

questions: what firewall should an ipv6 cpe have
